meta.defaultDescription: Adulis is a commerce layer for sellers whose audience already lives on TikTok and Instagram. Sellers pay a subscription. Buyers pay sellers directly.

home.pageTitle: Adulis — a shop for sellers whose buyers already follow them
home.headlineLine1: Sell where your audience already knows you.
home.headlineLine2: Give those orders somewhere better than your DMs.
home.sub: The people following you already ask for prices, sizes, stock and delivery. Adulis gives those existing buyers a proper shop instead of another chat thread.

value.goodsBody: Cosmetics, clothing and electronics — real delivery, real buyers.
value.payBody: By bank transfer. Adulis never holds or touches buyer money.
value.evidenceBody: Reviews backed by evidence of a handoff, not just comments.

howItWorks.heading: How Adulis works
howItWorks.sub: Simple for buyers. Powerful for sellers.

steps.title: The seller posts as usual
steps.body: They keep posting on TikTok and Instagram. Their Adulis shop link sits in their bio.

steps.title: The follower sees the real thing
steps.body: They tap the bio link and land on the seller's Adulis shop — identity, verification, completed orders, live stock, and when stock was last confirmed.

steps.title: Identity starts in the app
steps.body: Browsing the web shop needs no account. The first time a buyer reserves, they sign in with their phone — in the app.

steps.title: The buyer pays the seller directly
steps.body: Adulis shows the seller's bank details. The buyer transfers and uploads the receipt. The seller checks their own bank account and confirms.

steps.title: The handoff becomes a record
steps.body: The buyer scans a QR code in the app. The order closes with evidence both sides can point to.

howItWorks.moneyTitle: The money never passes through Adulis.
howItWorks.moneyBody: The buyer transfers directly to the seller's bank account. The seller confirms it against their own records. Adulis holds no funds and verifies no payments — it records what both sides did.

paste.titleSeller: Saved the video but not the link?
paste.titleBuyer: Saved the video but lost the link?
paste.bodySeller: A buyer who saved the post can paste that link into the Adulis app. Because one video often shows several items, Adulis returns every product that seller tagged with that post — and the buyer picks the one they want.
paste.bodyBuyer: Paste the post link into Adulis. If the video showed several items, you'll see all of them and can pick.

forSellers.heading: Built for sellers who already have an audience.
forSellers.sub: You built the following. Adulis turns it into a shop that runs itself between posts.
forSellers.problemsHeading: What breaks when you sell in DMs

problems.title: Orders buried in DMs
problems.body: A real order should not disappear inside a long chat thread.

problems.title: The same question 40 times
problems.body: Price, size, stock and delivery should not need the same reply all week.

problems.title: No way to prove you're real
problems.body: Anyone can buy followers. Nothing separates you from someone who did.

problems.title: Reputation lives in comments
problems.body: A good record should be countable, not argued about.

benefits.title: An ordered storefront
benefits.body: Your products in the order you choose, not in the order you posted them.

benefits.title: A chatbot that answers for you
benefits.body: Price, stock, sizes and delivery, answered from your own product data. Free during the beta and for your first 60 days. Part of a paid plan after that.

benefits.title: Reservations that hold stock
benefits.body: A buyer reserves, stock is held, and it releases automatically if they don't pay.

benefits.title: Verified identity
benefits.body: Prove you control your social account. Government ID verification available.

benefits.title: Reviews backed by evidence
benefits.body: A review carries its strongest badge when the buyer scanned at handoff.

benefits.title: Your numbers, published
benefits.body: Completed orders, cancellation rate, stock accuracy. Facts, not opinions.

forSellers.notDoBody: Adulis does not hold your money, take a commission, deliver your goods, or handle your refunds. You own your product, your price, your stock accuracy and your fulfilment. Adulis gives you the tools and the record.
forSellers.betaBody: The beta cohort is small and hand-picked. Beta sellers pay nothing. We contact everyone who applies.

waitlist.heading: Join the seller waitlist
waitlist.sub: Access is limited during the controlled beta. Everyone who applies is reviewed.

fields.secondHandleHelp: Only if you sell on a second platform.

forBuyers.heading: Buy from the people you already follow.
forBuyers.sub: You found them on TikTok or Instagram. Adulis is where the order actually happens — with real stock, a real identity, and a record of the handoff.

value.title: See what's actually in stock
value.body: Live stock counts with the time they were last confirmed. Not a guess in a DM.

value.title: Know who you're buying from
value.body: Verified identity, completed order count, and published cancellation and stock-accuracy rates.

value.title: A record of the handoff
value.body: You scan a QR code when you receive your order. That's what makes your review count.

steps.title: Tap the seller's link
steps.body: From their TikTok or Instagram bio. Their shop opens — you can browse without an account.

steps.title: Reserve in the app
steps.body: Sign in with your phone the first time. Your items are held while you pay.

steps.title: Pay the seller directly
steps.body: Transfer to their bank account and upload the receipt. They confirm it against their own bank.

steps.title: Scan at handoff
steps.body: When your order arrives, you scan the QR code. The order closes with evidence on both sides.

forBuyers.notDoBody: Adulis never holds your money and never verifies a transfer. You pay the seller directly, and the seller is responsible for your order, delivery and any refund. If something goes wrong you can raise a claim, and Adulis will give you everything it has on record — but it cannot refund you.

trust.heading: Trust built on facts, not opinions.
trust.sub: Adulis publishes what it can prove from its own records — and is explicit about what it does not do.

boundaries.title: We never hold your money
boundaries.body: Buyers pay the seller. No escrow. No wallet. No middleman.

boundaries.title: We never verify your payments
boundaries.body: Buyers upload receipts. Sellers confirm in their own bank account. Adulis records both.

boundaries.title: We never characterise sellers
boundaries.body: We publish counted facts from our records — completed orders, cancellation rate and stock accuracy.

boundaries.title: Evidence over opinions
boundaries.body: Reviews are tied to completed handoffs. Opinions without proof do not determine reputation.

verification.title: Account control
verification.body: The seller posts a one-time code to their linked social account. Adulis checks it. Free, all sellers.

verification.title: Government ID
verification.body: Verified through a third-party provider. Adulis never stores identity photographs — only a record that the check happened.

trust.ladderNote: A level is earned, never bought. No subscription tier, payment or advertising spend moves a seller up. Levels fall as well as rise. Thresholds are undecided.
trust.publishNote: Every one of these is a count from our own records. Adulis never calls a seller a scammer, a fraud or a criminal, and never asserts wrongdoing.
trust.wrongBody: A buyer can raise a claim. Adulis reviews it against the evidence it already holds — chat history, scan records, payment receipts, stock history — and produces an evidence export the buyer can use. Adulis does not refund buyers and does not file police reports.

prohibited.heading: Prohibited Products
prohibited.noteBody: These categories cannot be sold through Adulis. Applicable law and Adulis policy always apply.

about.heading: About Adulis
about.sub: Adulis gives sellers the tools to run their business professionally, protect their reputation and grow with their audience.
about.originBody1: Naod Solomon ran a shop selling through TikTok and Instagram for three years, handling around 50 orders a month there — against about five a month on Jiji and Facebook Marketplace combined.
about.originBody2: Adulis is being built around that behaviour: people follow a seller, want a real physical product, then have to finish the purchase inside a DM thread.

explain.buyerBody: Your identity is scrubbed. Active unpaid reservations are released. Reviews you wrote are anonymised, not deleted. Transactional records are kept in anonymised form.
explain.sellerBody: Deletion is blocked while any order, payment, refund or claim is unresolved — we'll show you exactly what's outstanding. Your storefront is unpublished immediately. Reviews buyers wrote about you are anonymised, not deleted. Your verification record is retained.

blocked.title: We can't delete this account yet.
blocked.intro: These need to be resolved first:

items.title: 2 orders awaiting handoff
items.action: complete or cancel these in the app

items.title: 1 payment awaiting your confirmation
items.action: confirm or reject it in the app

items.title: 1 open claim
items.action: this closes when the claim is resolved

blocked.note: Once these are clear, come back and start again.

success.title: Your account has been deleted.
success.body: Reviews and transactional records are retained in anonymised form, and moderation records are kept in full.

manual.title: How to request deletion
manual.body: Deletion is handled by a person, not by a form on this page. Contact Adulis from the phone number on your account and ask for your account to be deleted. We confirm when it is done, and everything described above applies.
